verdict.rationale: Riveter supports scheduling projects to auto-refresh/monitor for changes and firing webhooks on run-completion events, which are limited forms of automated triggering, but there's no evidence of a general rules engine where users define arbitrary conditional logic ('if X happens, do Y') across different event types. missing for 10: user-defined conditional rule syntax, support for triggering on events beyond schedule/run-completion, examples of chained multi-step automated actions.
